notes:
- Keep Git History available when a saved branch or tag is deleted outside RebaseRaven.
- Load Git History and diffs with fewer Git calls. Share reference data with the branch list and reuse it across history pages.
- Update Git file changes sooner after staging, unstaging, or working tree edits. Give foreground changes priority over automatic fetches.
- Show Perforce pending changelists sooner and fill in locks, conflicts, and unchanged states afterward. Keep existing status indicators visible during refresh.
- Keep large Perforce changelists responsive when scrolling and reuse recent results when switching tabs.
- Apply Ignore Whitespace during the first Perforce diff for opened, shelved, and submitted files.
